the institutional theory of organizations has not yet been fully developed.

normative conformity is a more likely driver of decoupling and customization while informational conformity is a more common driver of abandonment.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the micro dynamics of adoption decisions and their post adoption consequences are shaped by the interplay between normative and information conformity.
organizational decision making is driven by both normative conformity and informational conformity and that the relative importance of these two motivational drivers varies by context.
